incomeDefinition: Segment sales are shown before removing sales between parts of the group.
profitMetric: Segment profit before interest and tax
definition: Reported segment profit after the segment costs shown in the filing, before the group subtracts finance costs, adds its share of its associate’s profit, and pays tax.
location: Q4 FY26 consolidated results and the following Consolidated Segment Information table, annual audited column and notes 5–6.
notes: The group removes ₹0.3445 crore of internal sales to reach ₹2,326.3652 crore of revenue from operations. Audited group profit after tax was ₹239.5625 crore, of which ₹230.1822 crore belonged to DOMS shareholders. The year includes Super Treas from 1 June 2025 and a full year of Uniclan, so the group is larger than in the comparison year. DOMS reported that the extra employee-benefit expense from new labour rules was immaterial.
insight: Stationery accounts for most of both the sales and the reported segment profit. The hygiene row covers a separate set of products.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment revenue before internal sales are removed
